title: ICAB P7 - IT Governance
format: Written & IS Audit Technical Paper (Aligned with CISA)
summary: Aligned with ISACA CISA standards, covering IT policies and cyber laws, COBIT/ITIL governance frameworks, Information Systems audit process, cybersecurity, BCP/DRP, and Big Data/AI.

all.name: Full Syllabus Tracker
all.blurb: Official 2025 Syllabus chapter and topic tracker for IT Governance. Track your study progress across all syllabus areas.

stages.title: Area 1: IT Policies, Cyber Laws & Data Protection
stages.name: Area 1: IT Policies, Cyber Laws & Data Protection
stages.description: National IT Policy 2018, Cyber Security Act 2023, ICT Act 2006, and international data laws (GDPR).

nodes.name: National Cyber Legislation & Regulatory Compliance
nodes.description: National IT Policy 2018 strategic objectives; Information and Communication Technology (ICT) Act 2006 (amended 2013); Cyber Security Act 2023; digital evidence admissibility; legal protections for critical information infrastructure (CII); GDPR and global data compliance.
topics: National IT Policy 2018: Vision for digital economy, governance, and human capital
ICT Act 2006 & Cyber Security Act 2023: Offenses, unauthorized access, hacking, electronic fraud
Critical Information Infrastructure (CII): Identification, security audits, and penalties for attack
Electronic signatures and legal evidentiary value of digital records
Data privacy principles and cross-border data transfer rules under GDPR and local laws
Intellectual property in software, copyright, and software licensing compliance
learningOutcomes: Evaluate enterprise compliance with Bangladesh Cyber Security Act 2023.
Determine legal admissibility requirements for digital audit evidence.
Assess GDPR risks for cross-border e-commerce and financial platforms.
checklists: Read National Cyber Legislation & Regulatory Compliance in ICAB Study Manual
resources: Relevant Acts & Standards (IFRS / ISA / Tax Acts)

stages.title: Area 2: IT Governance Frameworks & Board Oversight
stages.name: Area 2: IT Governance Frameworks & Board Oversight
stages.description: COBIT 2019, ITIL 4, ISO/IEC 27001, IT steering committees, and IT investment governance.

nodes.name: COBIT 2019, ITIL 4 & Strategic Alignment
nodes.description: IT governance principles and Board oversight; COBIT 2019 framework (Governance vs Management, 40 core objectives); ITIL 4 service management; ISO/IEC 27001 Information Security Management System (ISMS); IT strategy committee and steering committee roles; IT balanced scorecard.
topics: Definition of IT Governance and difference between governance and management
COBIT 2019 architecture: Governance System Principles, Design Factors, Focus Areas
COBIT domains: EDM (Evaluate, Direct, Monitor), APO, BAI, DSS, MEA
ITIL 4 Service Value System (SVS) and Service Value Chain
Role of IT Strategy Committee at the Board level and executive IT Steering Committee
IT risk management frameworks: Risk appetite, risk register, and heat maps
Measuring IT value delivery using IT Balanced Scorecard
learningOutcomes: Design enterprise IT governance structures applying COBIT 2019.
Establish roles for Board IT Strategy Committees.
Evaluate IT service delivery against ITIL 4 standards.
checklists: Read COBIT 2019, ITIL 4 & Strategic Alignment in ICAB Study Manual
resources: Relevant Acts & Standards (IFRS / ISA / Tax Acts)

stages.title: Area 3: Information Systems Audit Process & CAATs
stages.name: Area 3: Information Systems Audit Process & CAATs
stages.description: IS audit planning, ISACA Standards, testing IT controls, sampling, and CAATs.

nodes.name: IS Audit Execution, Controls Testing & CAATs
nodes.description: ISACA Information Systems Audit Standards and Code of Professional Ethics; risk-based IS audit planning; auditing IT General Controls (ITGC) and Application Controls; Computer-Assisted Audit Techniques (CAATs: IDEA, ACL); continuous auditing and reporting.
topics: ISACA IS Audit Standards, Guidelines, and Code of Professional Ethics
Developing a risk-based IS audit program and audit charter
Auditing IT General Controls: Logical access, physical security, program change management, computer operations
Auditing Application Controls: Input controls, processing controls, output controls, error handling
Computer-Assisted Audit Techniques (CAATs): Data extraction, reconciliation, duplicate detection using ACL/IDEA
Continuous auditing and automated continuous monitoring techniques
Drafting IS audit findings, risk ratings, and management recommendations
learningOutcomes: Conduct an IS audit in accordance with ISACA standards.
Perform comprehensive testing of ITGCs and application controls.
Apply CAATs for automated audit testing and fraud detection.
checklists: Read IS Audit Execution, Controls Testing & CAATs in ICAB Study Manual
resources: Relevant Acts & Standards (IFRS / ISA / Tax Acts)

stages.title: Area 4: Cybersecurity, BCP & Disaster Recovery
stages.name: Area 4: Cybersecurity, BCP & Disaster Recovery
stages.description: Threat intelligence, penetration testing, SOC, BCP/DRP testing, and ransomware resilience.

nodes.name: Cyber Defense, Incident Response & BCP/DRP
nodes.description: Defense-in-depth architecture; Security Operations Center (SOC); vulnerability assessments and penetration testing; cyber incident response plan; Business Impact Analysis (BIA); Business Continuity Plan (BCP) and Disaster Recovery Plan (DRP) testing methods (walkthrough, simulation, parallel, full interruption).
topics: Defense-in-depth principles: Perimeter security, endpoint protection, zero-trust architecture
Vulnerability scanning, ethical hacking, and penetration testing methodologies
Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) and 24/7 SOC monitoring
Cyber incident response lifecycle: Preparation, Detection, Containment, Eradication, Recovery
Business Impact Analysis (BIA): Determining critical business functions, RTO, and RPO
Disaster Recovery hot sites, warm sites, and cold sites evaluation
BCP/DRP testing types: Checklist review, tabletop walkthrough, simulation, parallel test, cutover
learningOutcomes: Evaluate zero-trust and defense-in-depth cybersecurity architectures.
Conduct a Business Impact Analysis (BIA) and establish recovery targets.
Design and evaluate disaster recovery testing exercises.
checklists: Read Cyber Defense, Incident Response & BCP/DRP in ICAB Study Manual
resources: Relevant Acts & Standards (IFRS / ISA / Tax Acts)

stages.title: Area 5: Big Data, AI & Emerging Tech in AIS
stages.name: Area 5: Big Data, AI & Emerging Tech in AIS
stages.description: Big Data in AIS, blockchain in auditing, AI-powered fraud detection, and cloud audit.

nodes.name: Big Data Analytics, Blockchain & AI in Audit
nodes.description: Big Data applications in Accounting Information Systems (AIS); blockchain technology for audit trail verification; Artificial Intelligence in forensic accounting and automated fraud detection; auditing cloud service providers and SOC reports (SOC 1, SOC 2 Type II).
topics: Big Data architecture in modern enterprise accounting systems
Using analytics and machine learning for journal entry testing and anomaly detection
Blockchain and smart contracts: Triple-entry bookkeeping and immutable audit logs
Auditing artificial intelligence algorithms: Bias, explainability, and validation
Third-party cloud vendor audits: Evaluating SOC 1 / SSAE 18 and SOC 2 Type II reports
learningOutcomes: Analyze Big Data in financial systems for fraud patterns.
Audit smart contracts and blockchain ledger transactions.
Interpret SOC 1 and SOC 2 reports for cloud outsourced services.
checklists: Read Big Data Analytics, Blockchain & AI in Audit in ICAB Study Manual
resources: Relevant Acts & Standards (IFRS / ISA / Tax Acts)
